description: This file defines a configuration class for interfacing with the Stability AI image editing API, extending a base configuration class. It includes methods for parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation to the Stability API format, and response transformation back to an OpenAI-compatible format. It is part of a larger image editing module, specifically tailored for Stability AI's API endpoints and parameters.

classes.name: StabilityImageEditConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Stability AI image editing, providing methods for parameter support, mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing tailored for Stability AI's API.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by Stability AI for image editing.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, image_edit_optional_params: ImageEditOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to Stability AI API parameters, handling specific conversions and filtering unsupported parameters.

methods.name: str _get_model_endpoint(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the API endpoint URL suffix based on the model name.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for a given model, base URL, and parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates environment settings and prepares headers with the necessary API key for Stability AI.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,RequestFiles] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms an OpenAI-style image edit request into the multipart/form-data format required by Stability AI API.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes the Stability AI response, converting it into an OpenAI-compatible ImageResponse object.

methods.name: bool use_multipart_form_data(self)
methods.description: Indicates that Stability AI requires multipart/form-data for image upload requests.
